tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
MikroTik hAP ax² (C52iG-5HaxD2HaxD-TC) Wi-Fi 6 Dual-Band Home Access Point Router


The MikroTik hAP ax² is a powerful, dual-band home and office router that brings the performance benefits of Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) into your network. Designed for speed, reliability, and flexibility, this next-generation router is ideal for high-demand environments, delivering better range, efficiency, and multi-device handling.

Key Features:

  • Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax): Enjoy faster speeds, improved range, and better performance in crowded environments with next-gen wireless technology.
  • Dual-Band Connectivity: Simultaneous 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands provide optimal performance for modern devices.
  • High-Speed Ports: Equipped with 5 Gigabit Ethernet ports for fast wired connections.
  • Powerful Hardware: Features a modern quad-core CPU and increased RAM for handling heavy traffic and multiple users.
  • Security & Control: Runs RouterOS v7, offering advanced routing, firewall, VPN, and bandwidth management tools.
  • Compact and Stylish: The sleek tower design blends well into any environment while ensuring optimal signal coverage.
